scenario: Cross-slot companion-slot read is ambiguous when multiple slots declare the same aggregation per LSER.6.9.3 — `m.mean` when both `Metrics.x` and `Metrics.y` declare `mean sliding 10_min` rejects with DS_VALIDATE_AMBIGUOUS_COMPANION_SLOT. Authors resolve via `as <label>` labels.
rules_ds:
use default

schema Metrics scope ttl 1_min:
    entity_id: String
    x: Float
    y: Float

series Metrics.x (by: entity_id):
    mean sliding 10_min

series Metrics.y (by: entity_id):
    mean sliding 10_min

rule r:
    Metrics m where m.mean > 0
->
    log info "ambig"
